info.name: OS Management Hub Managed Instance API
managedInstance
Gets a list of allmanaged instances in a compartment

params.name: compartmentId
params.description: The OCID of the compartment that contains the resources to list. This filter returns only resources contained within the specified compartment.

params.name: displayName
params.description: A filter to return resources that match the given display names.

params.name: displayNameContains
params.description: A filter to return resources that may partially match the given display name.

params.name: managedInstanceId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the managed instance. This filter returns resources associated with this managed instance.

params.name: status
params.description: A filter to return only managed instances whose status matches the status provided.

params.name: archType
params.description: A filter to return only instances whose architecture type matches the given architecture.

params.name: osFamily
params.description: A filter to return only resources that match the given operating system family.

params.name: isManagementStation
params.description: A filter to return only managed instances that are acting as management stations.

params.name: group
params.description: A filter to return only managed instances that are attached to the specified group.

params.name: groupNotEqualTo
params.description: A filter to return only managed instances that are NOT attached to the specified group.

params.name: lifecycleStage
params.description: A filter to return only managed instances that are associated with the specified lifecycle environment.

params.name: lifecycleStageNotEqualTo
params.description: A filter to return only managed instances that are NOT associated with the specified lifecycle environment.

params.name: isAttachedToGroupOrLifecycleStage
params.description: A filter to return only managed instances that are attached to the specified group or lifecycle environment.

params.name: softwareSourceId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the software source. This filter returns resources associated with this software source.

params.name: advisoryName
params.description:
The assigned erratum name. It's unique and not changeable.

Example: `ELSA-2020-5804`

params.name: lifecycleEnvironment
params.description: A filter to return only managed instances in a specific lifecycle environment.

params.name: lifecycleEnvironmentNotEqualTo
params.description: A filter to return only managed instances that aren't in a specific lifecycle environment.

params.name: location
params.description: A filter to return only resources whose location matches the given value.

params.name: locationNotEqualTo
params.description: A filter to return only resources whose location does not match the given value.

params.name: profile
params.description: A multi filter to return only managed instances that match the given profile ids.

params.name: profileNotEqualTo
params.description: A multi filter to return only managed instances that don't contain the given profile [OCIDs](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm).

params.name: isProfileAttached
params.description: A filter to return only managed instances with a registration profile attached.

params.name: isManagedByAutonomousLinux
params.description: Indicates whether to list only resources managed by the Autonomous Linux service.

params.name: agentVersion
params.description: A filter to return only managed instances with the specified version of osmh-agent running.

params.name: managementStation
params.description:
A filter to return resources that are associated with the specified management 
station [OCIDs](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm).

params.name: managementStationNotEqualTo
params.description:
A filter to return resources that aren't associated with the specified management 
station [OCIDs](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm).

params.name: isRebootRequired
params.description: A filter to return only managed instances that require a reboot to install updates.

params.name: limit
params.description:
For list pagination. The maximum number of results per page, or items to return in a paginated "List" call.
For important details about how pagination works, see [List Pagination](/iaas/Content/API/Concepts/usingapi.htm#nine).

Example: `50`

params.name: page
params.description:
For list pagination. The value of the `opc-next-page` response header from the previous "List" call.
For important details about how pagination works, see [List Pagination](/iaas/Content/API/Concepts/usingapi.htm#nine).

Example: `3`

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The sort order to use, either 'ASC' or 'DESC'.

params.name: sortBy
params.description: The field to sort by. Only one sort order may be provided. Default order for timeCreated is descending. Default order for displayName is ascending.

items.docs: Lists managed instances that match the specified compartment or managed instance OCID. Filter the list against a variety of criteria including but not limited to its name, status, architecture, and OS version.

info.name: Installs all Windows Updates on managed instances in a compartment

items.docs: Installs all of the available Windows updates for managed instances in a compartment. This applies only to standalone Windows instances. This will not update instances that belong to a group.

info.name: Update all packages on managed instances in a compartment

items.docs: Install all of the available package updates for all of the managed instances in a compartment. This applies only to standalone non-Windows instances. This will not update instances that belong to a group or lifecycle environment.

info.name: Get ManagedInstance

params.name: managedInstanceId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the managed instance.

items.docs: Gets information about the specified managed instance.

info.name: Update the managed instance identified by the id

params.name: managedInstanceId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the managed instance.

items.docs: Updates the specified managed instance information, such as description, ONS topic, and associated management station.

info.name: Delete (unregister) a provisioned Managed Instance

params.name: managedInstanceId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the managed instance.

items.docs:
Unregisters the specified managed instance from the service. Once unregistered, the service will no longer manage the instance. 
For Linux instances, yum or DNF repository files will be restored to their state prior to registration.

info.name: Add a profile to a managed instance

params.name: managedInstanceId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the managed instance.

items.docs:
Adds profile to a managed instance. After the profile has been added,
the instance can be registered as a managed instance.

info.name: Add a software source to a managed instance

params.name: managedInstanceId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the managed instance.

items.docs:
Adds software sources to a managed instance. After the software source has been added,
then packages from that software source can be installed on the managed instance.

info.name: Detach a profile from a managed instance

params.name: managedInstanceId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the managed instance.

items.docs:
Detaches profile from a managed instance. After the profile has been removed,
the instance cannot be registered as a managed instance.

info.name: Removes software sources from a managed instance

params.name: managedInstanceId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the managed instance.

items.docs:
Removes software sources from a managed instance.
Packages will no longer be able to be installed from these software sources.

info.name: Disable a specific module stream on a managed instance

params.name: managedInstanceId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the managed instance.

items.docs:
Disables a module stream on a managed instance.  After the stream is
disabled, it is no longer possible to install the profiles that are
contained by the stream.  All installed profiles must be removed prior
to disabling a module stream.

info.name: Enable a specific module stream on a managed instance

params.name: managedInstanceId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the managed instance.

items.docs:
Enables a module stream on a managed instance.  After the stream is
enabled, it is possible to install the profiles that are contained
by the stream.  Enabling a stream that is already enabled will
succeed.  Attempting to enable a different stream for a module that
already has a stream enabled results in an error.

info.name: Install packages on a managed instance

params.name: managedInstanceId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the managed instance.

items.docs: Installs packages on a managed instance.

info.name: Installs snaps on a managed instance

params.name: managedInstanceId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the managed instance.

items.docs: Installs specified snaps on a managed instance.

info.name: Installs a profile for an enabled module stream

params.name: managedInstanceId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the managed instance.

items.docs:
Installs a profile for an module stream.  The stream must be
enabled before a profile can be installed.  If a module stream
defines multiple profiles, each one can be installed independently.

info.name: Install Windows update(s) on a managed instance

params.name: managedInstanceId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the managed instance.

items.docs: Installs Windows updates on the specified managed instance.

info.name: Perform an operation involving modules, streams, and profiles on a managed instance

params.name: managedInstanceId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the managed instance.

items.docs:
Enables or disables module streams and installs or removes module stream profiles. Once complete, the state of the modules, streams, and 
profiles will match the state indicated in the operation. See [ManageModuleStreamsOnManagedInstanceDetails](#/en/osmh/latest/datatypes/ManageModuleStreamsOnManagedInstanceDetails) 
for more information. You can preform this operation as a dry run. For a dry run, the service evaluates the operation against the 
current module, stream, and profile state on the m

info.name: Reboots a managed instance

params.name: managedInstanceId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the managed instance.

items.docs:
Initiates a reboot of the specified managed instance. You can also specify the number of minutes the service 
waits before marking the reboot operation as failed.

info.name: Refresh the software information

params.name: managedInstanceId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the managed instance.

items.docs: Refreshes the package or Windows update information on a managed instance with the latest data from the software source. This does not update packages on the instance. It provides the service with the latest package data.

info.name: Removes a package from a managed instance

params.name: managedInstanceId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the managed instance.

items.docs: Removes an installed package from a managed instance.

info.name: Remove snaps from a managed instance

params.name: managedInstanceId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the managed instance.

items.docs: Removes specified snaps from a managed instance.

info.name: Removes an installed profile for a module stream from a managed instance

params.name: managedInstanceId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the managed instance.

items.docs:
Removes a profile for a module stream that is installed on a managed instance.
If a module stream is provided, rather than a fully qualified profile, all
profiles that have been installed for the module stream will be removed.

info.name: Changes the enabled stream for a module

params.name: managedInstanceId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the managed instance.

items.docs:
Enables a new stream for a module that already has a stream enabled.
If any profiles or packages from the original module are installed,
switching to a new stream will remove the existing packages and
install their counterparts in the new stream.

info.name: Switch snap channel on a managed instance

params.name: managedInstanceId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the managed instance.

items.docs: Switches the snap channel on a managed instance.

info.name: Update a package on a managed instance

params.name: managedInstanceId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the managed instance.

items.docs: Updates a package on a managed instance.
